text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"རིག་པ་དང་སྐྱེས་བུའི་དངོས་གྲུབ་དང་། ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོའི་དངོས་གྲུབ་ནི་རིགས་པའི་སྐྱེས་བུའི་དངོས་གྲུབ་སྟེ།","english":"The attainment of knowledge and the person, and the attainment of the Great Seal, are the attainment of the person of the family","kind":"sense","why":"The source says the attainment of knowledge/person and Mahamudra are the attainment of the 'person of the family' (rigs kyi skyes bu), but the English translates 'rigs' as 'family' while the source uses 'rigs' (family) and 'rig pa' (knowledge) distinctly.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: The attainment of knowledge and the person, and the attainment of the Great Seal, are the attainment of the person of the family
contradictions.why: The source says the attainment of knowledge/person and Mahamudra are the attainment of the 'person of the family' (rigs kyi skyes bu), but the English translates 'rigs' as 'family' while the source uses 'rigs' (family) and 'rig pa' (knowledge) distinctly.
